title: EMT conduit, 1 in trade size, 10 ft stick

sources.citation: real-world: 1 trade size steel EMT, outside diameter 1.163 in = 29.54 mm, nominal wall 0.057 in = 1.45 mm; steel-EMT makers’ published dimension tables for ANSI C80.3 / UL 797 tubing (cited by number), read 2026-11-12. No NEC Chapter 9 table is used. The body box rounds the diameter up to 30 mm (even, so the ends sit on whole millimetres).

real-world: EMT is sold in 10 ft (3048 mm) lengths (makers’ packaging tables, read 2026-11-12); sizeMm is the uncut stick along +x and the body diameter (30 mm). Cut ends are taken as square and reamed (no burr modelled).
game-design: a new stick is cut to 1000 mm; raceway.cut makes pieces from 50 mm to the full stick.
